Paper_name: Data for Training Effect of Self Prioritization
Summary: Cleaned, de-identified, minimally preprocessed trial-level behavioral data of two self-prioritization experiments: Experiment 1 collected by Chuan-Peng Hu et al. (2015, Tsinghua University, Beijing) with two association tasks (association-type-matching and self-matching), and Experiment 2 collected by Chenghao Zhou et al. (2023, Henan University, Kaifeng), a matching-verification training study. Participants learned shape-label associations and judged whether each presented shape-label pair matched the learned association. Year refers to the year of this data record (2026); the data-collection periods are 2015 (Experiment 1) and 2023 (Experiment 2) as recorded in Collected_date of the experiment JSONs. Data follow the SPE Database schema (v2).
Author: Yuqian Hu; Chenghao Zhou; Yanan Chen; Kaiping Peng; Jie Sui; Hu Chuan-Peng
Extra_Var: association type (self-other / happy-neutral / high-low reward); emotional expression; training group
Conclusion: The dataset bundles two experiments: Experiment 1 (Beijing 2015) with an association-type-matching task (self-other, happy-neutral and high-low reward associations) and a self-matching task (self/friend/stranger identity x emotional expression); Experiment 2 (Kaifeng 2023) with matching-verification training (matching-first vs nonmatching-first groups; baseline, training 1-7 and post-test). See the experiment JSONs for full design details.
